description_zh: 前车在车道内倒车平行泊车，与静止的 Waymo AV 发生碰撞，因核心机动涉及倒车/后退，排除。
reason: 核心机动涉及倒车/后退（reverse/backing），CARLA 无法实现，且属于 NHTSA 非 V2V 子集，因此排除。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was traveling northbound on Larkin Street when a passenger car traveling directly in front of the Waymo AV stopped in lane, and began to reverse to parallel park at the curb.
While the passenger car was reversing, the rear driver side of the passenger car made contact with the front passenger side of the stationary Waymo AV.
